About NOBACHAP

A simpler way to get the appliances you want.

NOBACHAP is a home appliances and accessories business built around customer requests. Instead of limiting you to what is on a shelf, we help you identify, pre-order and receive the right appliance for your home, lifestyle and budget.

From your first enquiry through sourcing, payment and delivery, our goal is to make every stage clear, convenient and dependable.
